en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small coastal harbor with calm water in the foreground and a low shoreline village in the background. Several small fishing boats lie on the water, and on the right a concrete pier extends into the harbor, with a crowd of people gathered and a small motor vessel moored alongside. Low wooden houses and sheds line the shore, and at least one flagpole flies a Scandinavian-style cross flag. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and lower right corners.
